english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for hurrying or trying to get something done quickly.
This is the all-purpose choice for hurrying yourself or doing a task hastily.

examples.english: We need to hurry and finish this homework.
examples.traditional: 我哋要趕住做完呢份功課。

examples.english: I had to rush through my homework, so I had no time to think carefully.
examples.traditional: 我趕住做份功課，冇時間慢慢諗。
